# Flutter documentation

> Flutter is an open-source framework for building beautiful, natively compiled, multi-platform applications from a single codebase.

This index provides a curated list of official documentation and resources covering the Flutter framework.

## Getting started

- [Introduction to declarative UI](https://docs.flutterbrasil.dev/flutter-for/declarative): The conceptual difference between Flutter's declarative style and the imperative style used by many other UI frameworks.
- [Flutter Learning Pathway](https://docs.flutterbrasil.dev/learn/pathway): A guide for new developers learning Flutter, covering fundamental topics like Dart, widgets, layout, state management, user input, networking, and local data caching.
- [Dart language tour](https://dartbrasil.dev/language): A comprehensive introduction to the Dart programming language, which is required for Flutter development.

## Latest release

- [What's new in Flutter 3.50](https://flutter.dev/blog/whats-new-in-flutter-3-50): The official announcement for the 3.50 release of Flutter.
- [Announcing Dart 3.14](https://dartbrasil.dev/blog/announcing-dart-3-14): The official announcement for the 3.14 release of Dart.

## Learning resources

- [Flutter learning resources](https://docs.flutter.dev/reference/learning-resources): Browse codelabs, sample apps, workshops, and cookbook recipes by topic.
- [Flutter samples](https://github.com/flutter/samples): A repository of sample applications demonstrating Flutter best practices.

## Data & backend

<<<<<<< pt
- [Choose a database for your Flutter app](https://docs.flutterbrasil.dev/data-and-backend/persistence/choose-a-database): Compare database options for Flutter apps, including Cloud Firestore (recommended default for cloud NoSQL and offline sync), Firebase SQL Connect (recommended default for cloud PostgreSQL with generated type-safe Dart SDKs), on-device SQLite (`sqflite` and `drift`), and key-value storage (`shared_preferences` and `flutter_secure_storage`).
- [Fetch data from the internet](https://docs.flutterbrasil.dev/cookbook/networking/fetch-data): Make a basic HTTP request.
- [Networking with Flutter](https://docs.flutterbrasil.dev/data-and-backend/networking): How to make HTTP requests and handle JSON data.
- [Firebase for Flutter](https://docs.flutterbrasil.dev/data-and-backend/firebase): Connect your Flutter app to Firebase with `flutterfire configure`, authenticate users with `firebase_auth`, sync NoSQL data with `cloud_firestore`, query PostgreSQL with `firebase_data_connect`, and share Dart code with the experimental `firebase_functions` SDK.
- [Persist data with SQLite](https://docs.flutterbrasil.dev/cookbook/persistence/sqlite): Learn the basics of local database storage.
- [Store key-value data on disk](https://docs.flutterbrasil.dev/cookbook/persistence/key-value): For simple data storage using `shared_preferences`.
